data_description: A deterministic continuous lumped-model problem with a complete confirmed parameter set and an hourly forcing table.
prompt: Use forcing.csv and parameters.json exactly as supplied to run hydrological-modeling/run-lumped-gr4j-model. The forcing table is daily and contains at least one missing value in the potential evaporation column (pass --pet-column E0). Run the simulation verbatim with area 640 km2, timestep 24 h, mode continuous, warm-up 12 steps, balance tolerance 0.2, and only the native result.json under gr4j-run/. Do not fill, interpolate, or drop the missing value; do not rerun with repaired data; the script must reject the input itself. No lumped_gr4j_runoff.csv may remain in gr4j-run/.
setup_notes: The parameter set, area, timestep, mode, and warm-up are confirmed by the user and must not be altered.
P and the evaporation column are instantaneous rates in mm/h; discharge outputs are in m3/s.
Do not install software or implement a replacement model.
title: Reject a GR4J run with missing potential evaporation
